text: The Zorblax Mini Widget broke before I finished opening the box.
The Astro Toggle works sometimes, but its instructions are confusing.
The Lunar Latch is ordinary and does the small job I expected.
The Nova Spinner feels sturdy, although its case scratches easily.
The Comet Counter is clear, quick, and pleasant to use.
The Orbit Lever works well and the color markings are easy to read.
The Quasar Gauge is remarkably precise and needed no setup.
The Nebula Clip is the best tiny gadget in my workshop.
